stem: The diagram shows Imran's number line from $4000$ to $6000$. The interval is divided into four equal parts with marks at equal spacing.

parts.text: Which claim correctly reads the second mark after $4000$?

options.text: The second mark after $4000$ shows $5000$, because each equal part is $500$.
The second mark after $4000$ shows $4002$, treating each mark as one unit.
Reading $5000$ on the mark is what creates the equal spacing on the number line.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The $2000$-unit span splits into four equal parts of $500$, so two steps past $4000$ land on $5000$.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal parts of a 2000 span are 500 each; two steps give 5000. Counting marks as +1 swaps the step size. Saying the reading creates the spacing reverses the relation.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source triangle diagram as a 4000–6000 number line with four equal parts.
